string.text: Would you like to join one of my settlements?
Sure, I can use a safe place to rest and work. What do you need me to do?
Sure, I can help manage one of your settlements. Which camp should I head to?
No thanks, I'm doing fine on my own and prefer to keep traveling.
You don't have any settlements established yet. Deploy a workbench somewhere in the Zone first.
All of your active settlements are at full capacity. You'll need to place more beds before I can join.
None of your settlements with free beds is safe for me: my faction's enemies either control the area or already live there.
%s has joined %s and will head there shortly.
I want to assign you to a job in the camp.
What would you like me to do?
Go out and scavenge for supplies.
Alright, I'll pack up and head out. Check the camp chest in 24 hours.
Work on crafting ammunition at the bench.
Got it. Keep the workbench chest supplied with gunpowder and scrap metal.
Sure. Put any damaged weapons/outfits in the chest along with some food or vodka as payment.
Just relax and take it easy around the camp for now.

Good to be back on the trail. Let's go.

Return to your settlement duties at %s.

Sets the active area around a Camp Hub where placed structures are detected.

Idle settlers gather at a piano, radio or stove within this distance of the Camp Hub. One that strays farther than this (up to the Camp Boundary) is walked back. Job NPCs (cook, crafter, etc.) use the full Camp Boundary to reach their furniture. Default: 10m.

Max height difference allowed between a rival camp chest and the ground 5m around it. Rejects positions on steep hillsides where decorations would clip into terrain or float. Set higher (5-8m) to allow camps on moderately sloped terrain, lower (1-2m) for strict flat-ground only. Default: 2.5m.
Minimum distance from a smart terrain where rival camps can spawn. Wider ranges give the slope check more candidates to find flat ground. Default: 25m.
Maximum distance from a smart terrain where rival camps can spawn. Must be greater than Min. Default: 250m.
How long (in game hours) a rival camp squad occupies a camp before abandoning it. After this duration, the squad departs and the camp becomes unoccupied. Default: 24 game hours.

When ON, shows routine job-completion toasts (cook, craft, repair, scavenge, trader arrivals). When OFF, only danger/raid alerts are shown. Recommended OFF for players with multiple active camps to reduce toast spam.

Multiplies the output of each cook, crafter, medic, woodcutter, brewer and scrapper cycle, up to 3x. Set to 1 for vanilla balance, 2-3 for faster progression. Does NOT affect repairs, hunting or scavenge loot.
RU cost to fast-travel to a camp via the PDA Travel button. Set to 0 for free travel. Default: 2000 RU.
How aggressively raids scale with defense deficit. Higher = more frequent raids when defenses are low. Default: 3.
Can you work as a medic at the medstation?
Understood. I'll prepare medical supplies at the medstation.
Need %d RU to fast-travel to this camp.
You're already on this level. Walk to your camp.
Cross-level travel not supported. Walk to a level transition.
Caravan summoned! A trader will arrive shortly.
A caravan was recently summoned. Wait a while.
A caravan is already at this camp.
Dismantle this settlement? Settlement tracking, zone, and settler assignments will be removed. Workbenches and storage containers remain safe in the world.
Settlement disbanded. Workbenches and storage containers remain intact.
Morale at %s is low (%d%%). Survivors may abandon the camp!
Morale at %s is high (%d%%). Production bonus active!
%s has abandoned %s due to low morale!
Raid on %s repelled! Raiders killed: %d, guards lost: %d.
Raid on %s succeeded! Camp ransacked, supplies stolen.
Minimum required distance between different Settlement Camp Hubs to prevent overlap.
Game hours between survivor job outputs (crafting, repairing, cooking, scavenging).
Real minutes between cook job processing runs. Progress advances live while playing, not only when sleeping/waiting.
Real minutes between ammo crafting and turret maintenance runs. Progress advances live while playing.
Real minutes between gear repair job processing runs. Progress advances live while playing.
Real minutes between scavenger loot return checks. Progress advances live while playing.
Percentage chance that a scavenger gets ambushed, returning empty-handed and needing rest.
Minimum amount of loot items a successful scavenger returns with.
Maximum amount of loot items a successful scavenger returns with.
Percentage of condition restored to a weapon, outfit, or helmet per repair cycle. Default: 25% (requires 4 cycles to repair from 0% to 100%).
When enabled, crafters prioritize producing 9x19mm and 9x18mm ammunition if the camp has auto-turrets, keeping defensive turrets continuously reloaded. Default: ON.
Game hours between fridge preservation runs in the camp chest.
Incremental condition restored to fresh foods (+0.25 is default).
Game hours between clean water generation runs by active pumps.

Game hours between settler meals. Each settler eats 1 food item from camp storage per cycle (default 24 hours = 1 food per settler per day). Settlers continue to consume rations continuously even when you are away on other maps.
Minimum game hours between camp raids.
Base chance of a raid triggering during checking interval.
Minimum game hours between random camp events (refugees, merchant, mutant migrations).
Percentage chance of triggering a random event.
Percentage chance that clearing a rival camp results in random faction takeover rather than dismantling.
Clears all current rival camps and resets the dynamic lifecycle so outposts establish organically over time. Option auto-resets.
Uninstall Prep: Purge All Rival Camp Furniture
Releases all tracked rival-camp furniture and decorations from the save using ALife release, then resets this toggle. Use before removing Homestead.
Homestead uninstall prep complete. Rival camp furniture released: %d

Maximum defense rating a camp can reach. Prevents stacking gadgets/turrets from making raids impossible. Default: 150.
The base chance (in percent) for same-faction generic stalkers to join your camp. This is further increased by player rank and faction goodwill. Default: 15%.
Controls maximum active rival/competing outposts across the Zone. Supports high density across all levels. Default: 25.
Maximum rival outposts allowed to spawn on a single map level. Default: 3.
Minimum distance between separate rival camps. Lower values allow competing factions to set up close to each other, sparking territorial battles. Default: 35m.
How many in-game hours must pass between rival camp establishment attempts. Default: 3 hours.
Probability that a rival faction establishes a new camp when the interval timer expires. Default: 33%.
Enables rival camps to evolve from basic scout camps (Tier 1) into fortified outposts (Tier 2) and heavily defended regional strongholds (Tier 3) over time.
Friendly and neutral rival outposts broadcast emergency radio calls when under attack. Responding and defending them rewards money and faction goodwill.
Enables supply courier squads to physically travel across maps delivering food, medical supplies, and ammunition to advanced rival outposts.
Blowouts and psy-storms can zombify exposed wilderness outposts, and mutant attacks can convert fallen camps into active mutant breeding dens.
Eliminating hostile rival camps has a chance to provoke the defeated faction into deploying a dedicated retaliation hit squad.
Grants health, stamina, and psy recovery buffs when resting near campfires at friendly rival outposts.

See the structured guide sections below.

%c[255,238,196,112]>> 1. PLACING A SETTLEMENT HUB%c[default]
 
 - %c[255,238,196,112]Workbench Core:%c[default] Place any %c[255,100,200,255]Hideout Furniture Workbench%c[default] (Workshop Bench, Crafting Table, Vise Table, or Anvil).
 - %c[255,238,196,112]Auto-Registration:%c[default] Placing the workbench instantly registers the location as an active settlement hub.
 - %c[255,144,238,144]Zone Network:%c[default] You can establish up to %c[255,144,238,144]8 independent settlements%c[default] across any connected maps in the Zone!
 - %c[255,238,196,112]Settlement Renaming:%c[default] Click %c[255,100,200,255]"Rename Settlement"%c[default] on the PDA Overview tab to assign custom names (e.g. "Rostok Outpost").
 
%c[255,238,196,112]>> 2. TERRITORY & BOUNDARY RADIUS%c[default]
 
 - %c[255,238,196,112]Active Radius:%c[default] Each base controls the area the %c[255,100,200,255]Camp Boundary Radius%c[default] sets around the hub: 50 meters by default, 20 to 100 in MCM.
 - %c[255,238,196,112]Structure Recognition:%c[default] Beds, workbenches, stoves, clinics, storage chests, barricades, and turrets placed within this radius are automatically linked.
 
%c[255,238,196,112]>> 3. SMART STORAGE & SUPPLY CHAINS%c[default]
 
 - %c[255,238,196,112]Container Distance:%c[default] Place camp storage chests and furniture %c[255,100,200,255]inside the Camp Boundary Radius%c[default], no more than 12 meters above or below your hub workbench.
 - %c[255,238,196,112]Universal Ingestion:%c[default] Settlers can pull required crafting and cooking ingredients from %c[255,100,200,255]any camp container%c[default] within the base radius.
 - %c[255,238,196,112]Thematic Deposits:%c[default] Finished goods and scavenged loot are automatically sorted into the most logical containers (Fridges, Gun Cabinets, Med Cabinets, Toolboxes, Ammo Boxes).

%c[255,238,196,112]>> 1. HOUSING CAPACITY (THE BED FORMULA)%c[default]
 
 - %c[255,144,238,144]Housing Formula:%c[default] %c[255,144,238,144]1 Bed / Couch / Stretcher = 1 Survivor Slot%c[default].
 - %c[255,238,196,112]Supported Furniture:%c[default] Sleeping Bags, Metal Frame Beds, Wooden Bunk Beds, Leather Couches, and Medical Stretchers.
 - %c[255,238,196,112]Capacity Scaling:%c[default] Build more beds to expand your base population (supports up to 10+ survivors per camp).
 
%c[255,238,196,112]>> 2. HOW TO RECRUIT STALKERS%c[default]
 
 - %c[255,238,196,112]Eligible Factions:%c[default] Friendly stalkers from Loners, Clear Sky, Duty, Freedom, Mercenaries, and Ecologists.
 - %c[255,238,196,112]Prerequisites:%c[default] Faction reputation >= 200 and available bed housing capacity.
 - %c[255,238,196,112]Signing Bonus:%c[default] By rank: novices and trainees join free; experienced %c[255,100,200,255]2,500 RU%c[default], professional 5,000, veteran 10,000, expert 16,000, master 25,000, legend 35,000. From veteran up the camp also needs Defense 25, 35, 50 or 60. MCM scales the fees or turns them off.
 - %c[255,144,238,144]Companions and Refugees:%c[default] Your companions pay the same fee; refugees join free.
 
%c[255,238,196,112]>> 3. REMOTE ROSTER MANAGEMENT (PDA)%c[default]
 
 - %c[255,238,196,112]Live Avatars & Dossiers:%c[default] View face portraits, health, assigned jobs, and XP progress in the %c[255,100,200,255]Survivors Tab%c[default].
 - %c[255,238,196,112]Remote Reassignment:%c[default] Change professions instantly from anywhere across the Zone.
 - %c[255,238,196,112]Inter-Base Transfer:%c[default] Relocate survivors between your 8 settlements with a single click.
 - %c[255,238,196,112]Banish Stalker:%c[default] Dismiss settlers if you need to free up housing capacity.

Homestead features %c[255,144,238,144]12 distinct settler roles%c[default] (11 active professions + Off-Duty/Idle). Assign jobs via direct dialogue or remotely in the %c[255,238,196,112]PDA Survivors Tab%c[default].\n \nSettlers autonomously run camp security, ammo crafting, weapon/armor repairs, gourmet cooking, hospital triage, wilderness expeditions, trophy hunting, power generation, forestry logging, alcohol distillation, and scrap metal salvage!

%c[255,238,196,112]>> BEHAVIOR & AMBIANCE%c[default]
 
 - Sits around lit campfires, plays acoustic guitar, drinks vodka and beer, sleeps in open beds, and socializes with fellow settlers.
 
%c[255,238,196,112]>> SETTLEMENT BENEFITS%c[default]
 
 - %c[255,144,238,144]+5 to +15 Camp Morale:%c[default] Generates passive morale over time when resting at well-equipped camps.
 - %c[255,238,196,112]Stress Recovery:%c[default] Provides a morale buffer after stressful raids, blowout storms, and mutant assaults.

%c[255,238,196,112]>> PATROLS & CHOKEPOINTS%c[default]
 
 - Patrols the base perimeter, garrisons sandbag bunkers, and mans watchtower vantage points with weapons drawn.
 
%c[255,238,196,112]>> COMBAT & SECURITY BENEFITS%c[default]
 
 - %c[255,144,238,144]+5 Defense Rating%c[default] per guard.

%c[255,238,196,112]>> EXPEDITION DISPATCH%c[default]
 
 - Autonomous scouts dispatched to recover marked secret stashes across any level of the Zone.
 - %c[255,100,200,255]Calibrated Speed:%c[default] 1.2 km/h = %c[255,144,238,144]5 in-game minutes per 100 meters%c[default] of physical distance.
 
%c[255,238,196,112]>> EXPEDITION DANGER & SALVAGE TIERS%c[default]
 
 - %c[255,238,196,112]Tier 1-2 (Cordon / Garbage / Valley):%c[default] Basic calibers, medkits, food, novice suits, Basic Toolkits.
 - %c[255,238,196,112]Tier 3-4 (Rostok / Army Warehouses / Red Forest):%c[default] NATO/Warsaw AP ammo, pristine WPO parts, Advanced Toolkits.
 - %c[255,144,238,144]Tier 5 (Outskirts / Pripyat / CNPP / Generators):%c[default] Expert Toolkits, Gauss/9x39 AP ammo, rare artifacts, and exoskeleton armor components!
 
%c[255,238,196,112]>> AMBUSHES & SPOILS%c[default]
 
 - Armed scavengers repel ambushes and return with bonus loot and combat XP.
 - Expeditions can be recalled early at any time from the PDA Survivors tab.

%c[255,238,196,112]>> WILDERNESS HUNTING EXPEDITIONS%c[default]
 
 - Dispatched into the surrounding wilderness to hunt mutants, skin beasts, and harvest valuable monster parts.
 - Yields fresh mutant meats (boar, flesh, pseudodog, bloodsucker, chimera), animal hides, and rare trophies.
 
%c[255,238,196,112]>> AMBUSH DANGER & EXPERIENCE%c[default]
 
 - Hunters face mutant pack ambushes in the wild; successful hunts award survival XP and higher harvest yields.
 
%c[255,238,196,112]>> SMART PANTRY STORAGE%c[default]
 
 - %c[255,144,238,144]Fridge & Pantry Priority:%c[default] Automatically stocks hunted meat directly into Camp Refrigerators and food containers for your Chef!

%c[255,238,196,112]>> WORKSTATION%c[default]
 
 - Requires Workbench, Placeable Workshop, Anvil, or Counter.
 
%c[255,238,196,112]>> AUTOMATED AMMO SYNTHESIS (EVERY 20 MINS BY DEFAULT)%c[default]
 
 - %c[255,238,196,112]Consumes:%c[default] 1x Gunpowder + 1x Metal Scrap from camp storage.
 - %c[255,144,238,144]Produces:%c[default] Boxed 9x18, 9x19, .45 ACP, 5.45x39, 5.56x45, 7.62x39, 7.62x54R, or 12x70 ammo.
 - %c[255,100,200,255]Thematic Storage:%c[default] Finished ammunition is deposited directly into camp Ammo Boxes and military chests.
 
%c[255,238,196,112]>> TURRET SERVICING%c[default]
 
 - Crafters automatically reload and maintain placed Pistol Turrets (+15 Defense each).
JOB: TECHNICIAN (REPAIR GUI, WPO RESTORATION & TOOLKITS)

%c[255,238,196,112]>> WORKSTATION%c[default]
 
 - Requires Repair Bench, Vise, Tool Table, or Workbench.
 
%c[255,238,196,112]>> 1. OFFICIAL VANILLA REPAIR & UPGRADE GUI%c[default]
 
 - Talk to your Technician to open the %c[255,100,200,255]official Anomaly Repair & Upgrade GUI%c[default] directly inside your base!
 
%c[255,238,196,112]>> 2. DYNAMIC WORK-SCALED WPO PRICING%c[default]
 
 - Price scales by weapon deficit + each damaged internal WPO part (barrel, bolt, trigger, gas tube, receiver):
 - %c[255,238,196,112]Type A (Pistols / Small SMGs):%c[default] 3-4 parts, ~45 RU/pt, capped at ~25,000 RU.
 - %c[255,238,196,112]Type B (Shotguns / Rifles):%c[default] 4-5 parts, ~95 RU/pt, capped at ~70,000 RU.
 - %c[255,238,196,112]Type C (Battle Rifles / SVD / 9x39):%c[default] 5-6 parts, ~175 RU/pt, capped at ~135,000 RU.
 - %c[255,238,196,112]Type D (Gauss / PKM / Heavy):%c[default] Hard ceiling of 200,000 RU.
 
%c[255,238,196,112]>> 3. 100% PARTS RESTORATION & UNJAMMING%c[default]
 
 - Paying for repair restores the weapon AND %c[255,144,238,144]all internal parts to 100% factory mint%c[default] with C++ misfire clearance.
 
%c[255,238,196,112]>> 4. TOOLKIT DELIVERIES & PASSIVE STORAGE REPAIR%c[default]
 
 - Deliver Basic, Advanced, and Expert Toolkits to unlock Tier 1-3 upgrades.
 - Technicians gradually repair damaged weapons and armor left in a workbench (the hub Workshop's storage, another Workshop or a repair bench) while you are near the camp. Each round takes one vodka, conserva or tushonka from camp storage.

%c[255,238,196,112]>> WORKSTATION%c[default]
 
 - Works from any camp container. A stove lets the cook make better meals; without one it cooks basic meals at a campfire.
 
%c[255,238,196,112]>> AUTOMATED COOKING (EVERY 15 MINS BY DEFAULT)%c[default]
 
 - %c[255,238,196,112]Consumes:%c[default] 1x Raw Mutant Meat from camp storage. On a stove also one use of charcoal, kerosene, a gas canister or a jerrycan, plus a clean water for a tier 2 meal or a vodka for a tier 3 meal. The tier is the higher of Cook Output Tier (MCM) and the cook's rank.
 - %c[255,144,238,144]Produces:%c[default] Non-irradiated cooked steaks, canned stews, and sausages.
 - %c[255,100,200,255]Pantry Deposit:%c[default] Meals are placed directly into Camp Refrigerators and pantries.
 
%c[255,238,196,112]>> HOSPITALITY BUFF%c[default]
 
 - Eating cooked meat or canned food at a base with Morale >= 50 (4 hours), or sleeping 3+ hours at one with Morale >= 60 (6 hours), restores %c[255,144,238,144]0.5% health and 5% stamina every 10 seconds%c[default] while it lasts.
JOB: MEDIC (DIAGNOSTIC TRIAGE, RAD PURGING & DRUGKITS)

%c[255,238,196,112]>> WORKSTATION%c[default]
 
 - Requires Medical Table, Clinic Equipment, or First Aid Station.
 
%c[255,238,196,112]>> COMPLETE DIAGNOSTIC TRIAGE MENU%c[default]
 
 - %c[255,100,200,255]Patch Wounds & Bleeding (1,850 RU):%c[default] Restores health, stamina, stops bleeding, heals Body Health System (BHS) limbs, and plays medkit animation.
 - %c[255,100,200,255]Cure Radiation Poisoning (1,480 RU):%c[default] Purges radiation to 0 mSv with anti-rad injection animation.
 - %c[255,100,200,255]Complete Treatment (3,350 RU):%c[default] Full physical and radiological restoration.
 
%c[255,238,196,112]>> DRUGKIT DELIVERIES & PHARMACY%c[default]
 
 - Synthesizes Bandages (1x Vodka or 1 cloth), AI-2 Medkits (4x Vodka + 1 Bandage), Potassium Iodide (3x Vodka), and Ibuprofen (5x Vodka) directly into Medical Chests using Nemiroff Vodka provided by your Brewer. Each Vodka is one use; a bottle holds 3.
 - Production directives can be configured via dialogue or the PDA Survivors tab.
 - Delivering a %c[255,144,238,144]Drug-Making Kit%c[default] doubles pharmaceutical output (2x Boost)!
JOB: ELECTRICIAN (POWER GRID, LAMPS & BATTERY RECHARGING)

%c[255,238,196,112]>> CAMP ILLUMINATION & POWER GRID%c[default]
 
 - Keeps placed lamps lit: when a lamp is below half its fuel, the electrician uses one Battery Pack from camp storage and refills every such lamp. Without batteries in storage the job waits.
 - %c[255,144,238,144]Night Defense Boost:%c[default] Active lighting provides +5 Defense rating per illuminated sector.

%c[255,238,196,112]>> TIMBER HARVESTING & CHARCOAL PRODUCTION%c[default]
 
 - %c[255,144,238,144]Timber Cycle:%c[default] Fells trees to harvest wooden parts per cycle (configurable via MCM yield sliders). Handing the woodcutter a felling axe doubles the minimum harvest and boosts the maximum yield by half!
 - %c[255,144,238,144]Kiln Cycle:%c[default] Burns wood scraps in a camp kiln/fire to produce 3-5 bags of clean charcoal fuel (+2 bonus bags with an axe).
 - %c[255,238,196,112]Directives:%c[default] Switchable between Auto-Rotate (50/50 balance), Timber Focus (wood only), and Charcoal Focus (fuel only) via dialogue or the PDA.
 - %c[255,100,200,255]Storage Routing:%c[default] Timber and charcoal go to stoves first, then to the main chest and general storage.
JOB: BREWER (ALCOHOL DISTILLERY & MEDICAL SUPPLY CHAIN)

%c[255,238,196,112]>> DISTILLATION PROCESS%c[default]
 
 - %c[255,144,238,144]Workstation:%c[default] Requires a placed Milk Can (Bidon) or Camp Stove.
 - %c[255,238,196,112]Ingredients:%c[default] Consumes 10 wood scraps and 1 clean water to distill 2 bottles of Nemiroff Vodka.
 - %c[255,144,238,144]Distillery Kit Upgrade:%c[default] Delivering a Drug-Making Kit to the brewer doubles output to 4 bottles per cycle (2x Boost)!
 - %c[255,100,200,255]Medical Supply Chain:%c[default] Nemiroff Vodka is the essential precursor required by Settlement Medics to synthesize medicine.

%c[255,238,196,112]>> RECYCLING & HARVESTING%c[default]
 
 - %c[255,144,238,144]Workstation:%c[default] Requires an assembled Workbench.
 - %c[255,238,196,112]Production:%c[default] Gathers scrap metal and hardware fasteners from Zone debris per cycle (configurable via MCM yield sliders).
 - %c[255,144,238,144]Demolition Tools Upgrade:%c[default] Handing the scrapper a crowbar, sledgehammer, or toolkit doubles the minimum yield and raises the maximum yield by two thirds!
 - %c[255,100,200,255]Storage Routing:%c[default] Scrap goes to cases, bags and ammo boxes first, then to toolboxes and general storage; fasteners go to general storage.

%c[255,238,196,112]>> 1. 1-CLICK PDA AUTO-SORT%c[default]
 
 - Click %c[255,238,196,112]"Auto-Sort Inventory"%c[default] on the PDA Overview tab to instantly offload supplies into themed containers across your base.
 - %c[255,144,238,144]Your Gear Is Kept:%c[default] Weapons, armor, helmets, artifacts and devices (equipped or not), anything in a slot or on your belt, and quest items are NEVER touched!
 
%c[255,238,196,112]>> 2. 13-CATEGORY SMART STORAGE ROUTING%c[default]
 
Settlers and Auto-Sort route items to the most logical container inside the Camp Boundary Radius:
 - %c[255,100,200,255]Fridges & Pantries:%c[default] Food, drinks, clean water flasks, cooked meat, canned rations, monster cuts.
 - %c[255,100,200,255]Gun Cabinets & Racks:%c[default] Rifles, shotguns, pistols, snipers, repaired firearms.
 - %c[255,100,200,255]Ammo Boxes:%c[default] Boxed ammunition, loose cartridges, grenades, explosives.
 - %c[255,100,200,255]Toolboxes & Benches:%c[default] Repair kits, weapon parts, scrap metal, hardware fasteners, tools.
 - %c[255,100,200,255]Medical Cabinets:%c[default] Medkits, bandages, stimpacks, pills, rad cures, surgical drugs.
 - %c[255,100,200,255]Wardrobes & Lockers:%c[default] Armored suits, SEVA suits, helmets, gas masks, tactical vests.
 - %c[255,200,200,200]Camp Storage Fallback:%c[default] If a specialized container is not built, items safely route to your main Blue Chest.
 
%c[255,238,196,112]>> 3. REFRIGERATORS & SPOILAGE RESTORATION%c[default]
 
 - Placed fridges preserve food: every 12 game hours (MCM), raw meat, kolbasa and bread anywhere in camp storage regain 25% condition (MCM).
 
%c[255,238,196,112]>> 4. WATER PUMPS & BARRELS (CLEAN WATER FILTRATION)%c[default]
 
 - %c[255,100,200,255]How to Build:%c[default] In the Hideout Furniture crafting menu, craft and place a %c[255,144,238,144]Metal Barrel%c[default] or %c[255,144,238,144]Sink%c[default] (any prop named barrel, sink, pump, well, or bidon registers as a water pump).
 - %c[255,100,200,255]Filtration Cycle:%c[default] Every 6 hours (configurable in MCM), each pump/barrel produces a %c[255,100,200,255]Flask of Clean Water%c[default].
 - %c[255,238,196,112]Filter Requirement:%c[default] Consumes 1x Charcoal, Paper Filter, or Water Filter from camp storage per batch. Keep charcoal or paper in your chests!
 - %c[255,144,238,144]Storage Destination:%c[default] Pure water flasks automatically deposit straight into your %c[255,100,200,255]Camp Refrigerator%c[default] (or main Blue Chest if no fridge exists), ready for drinking or distillery brewing!
5. BASE DEFENSE, TURRETS, GADGETS & RAID DEFENSE

%c[255,238,196,112]>> DEFENSE STRUCTURE RATINGS%c[default]
 
 - %c[255,144,238,144]Pistol Turret:%c[default] +15 Defense (Automated 360-degree perimeter fire).
 - %c[255,144,238,144]Guards:%c[default] +5 Defense per guard.
 - %c[255,144,238,144]Alarm Siren:%c[default] +10 Defense. An active (switched-on) siren also adds the Alarm Defense Bonus (+15 by default) during raid rolls.
 - %c[255,144,238,144]Barricades:%c[default] +2 Defense per sandbag, fence, board, plate, shield or door.
 - %c[255,144,238,144]Spotlights:%c[default] no Defense.
 - %c[255,144,238,144]Total:%c[default] at most the Defense Rating Cap (150 by default). A Military Outpost multiplies it by 1.5, the four other specializations by 0.75.
 
%c[255,238,196,112]>> HOSTILE RAIDS & SPOILS%c[default]
 
 - Raids come only while you are within the Event/Raid Player Distance (100 m by default) of a camp with settlers on your level, and never within the Camp Raid Cooldown (36 game hours by default) of the last raid or of the camp's founding.
 - After that, a raid is rolled every 10 seconds: the Raid Base Chance (15%) plus 3% (the Raid Defense Deficit Multiplier) for every Defense point short of 3 per settler. High Defense lowers the odds; it never stops raids.
 - Raiders are a random hostile squad, about one in three a mutant pack. Human squads get tougher with your rank, not with what the camp stores. Slain raiders can be looted.

%c[255,238,196,112]>> LIVING ZONE OUTPOSTS%c[default]
 
 - Dynamic outposts establish across the Zone, occupied by hostile factions (Bandits, Monolith, Mercenaries) or neutral/allied forces (Loners, Clear Sky, Duty, Freedom, Ecologists) depending on regional presence.
 - Review threat levels, garrison numbers, and tactical intel in the %c[255,238,196,112]PDA Outposts Tab%c[default].
 - %c[255,100,200,255]Locate on Map:%c[default] Click "Locate on Map" to center the PDA map on outpost coordinates.
 - %c[255,255,100,100]Assaulting Hostiles:%c[default] Clearing out hostile outposts yields massive loot caches, rare weaponry, and dismantles enemy supply networks.

%c[255,238,196,112]>> LIVE BASE INTERCEPTS%c[default]
 
 - Open the %c[255,238,196,112]Radio Feed Tab%c[default] to view real-time transmissions from your settlements:
 - %c[255,100,200,255]Expeditions:%c[default] Scavenger departures, route checkpoints, ambushes, and loot return summaries.
 - %c[255,144,238,144]Workshops:%c[default] Ammo crafted, food cooked, water pumped, timber logged, and items repaired.
 - %c[255,255,100,100]Combat & Raids:%c[default] Attack alarms, turret engagements, and defense victories.
 - %c[255,200,200,200]Filter Chips:%c[default] Use [All], [Exped], [Work], and [Combat] buttons to filter your log feed.

%c[255,238,196,112]>> CAMP SPECIALIZATIONS%c[default]
 
 - Cycle specialization on the Overview tab to focus base productivity:

 - %c[255,144,238,144]Agricultural Farm:%c[default] +50% Food & Water yield.
 - %c[255,238,196,112]Industrial Workshop:%c[default] +50% Crafting & Repair speed.
 - %c[255,200,200,200]Scavenger Hideout:%c[default] +50% Scavenger loot yield.
 - %c[255,144,238,144]Medical Clinic:%c[default] +100% Medicine production.
 
%c[255,238,196,112]>> TRADE CARAVANS%c[default]
 
 - Click %c[255,144,238,144]"Summon Trade Caravan"%c[default] to call traveling merchant stalkers directly to your settlement with ammo, food, and supplies!

%c[255,238,196,112]>> MCM OPTIONS MENU%c[default]
 
 - Open Main Menu -> Options -> Mod Configuration Menu (MCM) -> %c[255,238,196,112]Homestead%c[default]:
 - %c[255,200,200,200]Scavenger Walk Speed:%c[default] Adjust speed (Default: 1.2 km/h = 5 in-game mins per 100m).

%c[255,238,196,112]>> STEP-BY-STEP CHECKLIST%c[default]
 
 1. Place a %c[255,100,200,255]Workbench%c[default] in a safe shelter to establish your Hub.
 2. Place a %c[255,100,200,255]Storage Chest%c[default] inside the camp boundary.
 3. Place at least 2 %c[255,144,238,144]Sleeping Beds%c[default] for housing capacity.
 4. Recruit friendly stalkers or companions to join your base.
 5. Assign one %c[255,144,238,144]Guard%c[default] and one %c[255,238,196,112]Scavenger%c[default] via the PDA Survivors Tab.
 6. Place a %c[255,100,200,255]Cook Stove%c[default] and %c[255,100,200,255]Metal Barrel / Sink%c[default] (Water Pump) for self-sufficient sustenance.
 7. Place %c[255,255,100,100]Pistol Turrets%c[default] and an %c[255,255,100,100]Alarm Siren%c[default] for fortified defense.
 8. Use %c[255,238,196,112]"Auto-Sort Inventory"%c[default] whenever returning from the Zone!
